verses.sa: स्वाहा प्राणेभ्यः साधिपतिकेभ्यः। पृथिव्यै स्वाहा ऽग्नये स्वाहा ऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा वायवे स्वाहा। दिवे स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: svāhā prāṇebhyaḥ sādhipatikebhyaḥ pṛthivyai svāhā 'gnaye svāhā 'ntarikṣāya svāhā vāyave svāhā dive svāhā sūryāya svāhā
verses.en: Svaha to the Vital Breathings with their Coittrolling Lord! To tarth Svaha! To Agni Svaha! To Firmament Svaha! To Vayu Svaha! To Sky Svaha! To Surya Svaha!

verses.sa: दिग्भ्यः स्वाहा चन्द्राय स्वाहा नक्षत्रेभ्यः स्वाहा ऽद्भ्यः स्वाहा वरुणाय स्वाहा। नाभ्यै स्वाहा पूताय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: digbhyaḥ svāhā candrāya svāhā nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhā 'dbhyaḥ svāhā varuṇāya svāhā nābhyai svāhā pūtāya svāhā
verses.en: To the Quarters Svaha! To the Moon Svaha! To the Stars Svaha! To the Waters Svaha! To Varuna Svaha! To the Navel Svaha! To the Purified Svaha!

verses.sa: वाचे स्वाहा प्राणाय स्वाहा प्राणाय स्वाहा। चक्षुषे स्वाहा चक्षुषे स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vāce svāhā prāṇāya svāhā prāṇāya svāhā cakṣuṣe svāhā cakṣuṣe svāhā śrotrāya svāhā śrotrāya svāhā
verses.en: To Speech Svaha! To Breath Svaha! To Breath Svar! To Sight Svaha! To Sight Svaha! To Hearing Svaha! To Hearing Svaha!

verses.sa: मनसः काममाकूतिं वाचः सत्यमशीय। पशूनां रूपमन्नस्य रसो यशः श्रीः श्रयतां मयि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: manasaḥ kāmamākūtiṃ vācaḥ satyamaśīya paśūnāṃ rūpamannasya raso yaśaḥ śrīḥ śrayatāṃ mayi svāhā
verses.en: The wish and purpose of the mind and truth of speech may I obtain. Bestowed on me be cattle's form, sweet taste of food, and fame and grace. Svaha!

verses.sa: प्रजापतिः सम्भ्रियमाणः सम्राट् सम्भृतो वैश्वदेवः संसन्नो घर्मः प्रवृक्तस्तेज उद्यत आश्विनः पयस्यानीयमाने पौष्णो विष्यन्दमाने मारुतः क्लथन्। मैत्रः शरसि सन्ताय्यमाने वायव्यो ह्रियमाण आग्नेयो हूयमानो वाग्घुतः॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiḥ sambhriyamāṇaḥ samrāṭ sambhṛto vaiśvadevaḥ saṃsanno gharmaḥ pravṛktasteja udyata āśvinaḥ payasyānīyamāne pauṣṇo viṣyandamāne mārutaḥ klathan maitraḥ śarasi santāyyamāne vāyavyo hriyamāṇa āgneyo hūyamāno vāgghutaḥ
verses.en: Prajapati while in preparation; Samraj when prepared; All-Gods when seated; Gharma when heated with fire; Splendour when lifted up; the Asvins' while milk is poured in; Pushan's when the butter trickles down ff it; the Maruts when the milk is clotting; Mitra's when the milk's skin is spreading; Varuna when it is carried ofF; Agni's while offered as oblation; Vak when it has been offered,

verses.sa: सविता प्रथमेऽहन्नग्निर्द्वितीये वायुस्तृतीय आदित्यश्चतुर्थे चन्द्रमाः पञ्चम ऋतुः षष्ठे मरुतः सप्तमे बृहस्पतिरष्टमे। मित्रो नवमे वरुणो दशम इन्द्र एकादशे विश्वे देवा द्वादशे॥
verses.tr: savitā prathame'hannagnirdvitīye vāyustṛtīya ādityaścaturthe candramāḥ pañcama ṛtuḥ ṣaṣṭhe marutaḥ saptame bṛhaspatiraṣṭame mitro navame varuṇo daśama indra ekādaśe viśve devā dvādaśe
verses.en: Savitar on the first day; Agni on the second; Vayu on the third; Aditya the Sun on the fourth: Chandmmas the Moon on the fifth; itu on the sixth; the Maruts on the seventh; Brihaspati on the eighth; Mitra on the ninth; Varuna on the tenth; Indra on the eleventh; the All-Gods on the twelfth.

verses.sa: उग्रश्च भीमश्च ध्वान्तश्च धुनिश्च। सासह्वाँश्चाभियुग्वा च विक्षिपः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ugraśca bhīmaśca dhvāntaśca dhuniśca sāsahvāṃścābhiyugvā ca vikṣipaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Fierce; Terrible; The Resonant; The Roarer; Victorious; Assailant; and Dispeller. Svadha.'

verses.sa: अग्निं हृदयेनाशनिं हृदयाग्रेण पशुपतिं कृत्स्नहृदयेन भवं यक्ना। शर्वं मतस्नाभ्यामीशानं मन्युना महादेवमन्तःपर्शव्येनोग्रं देवं वनिष्ठुना वसिष्ठहनुः शिङ्गीनि कोश्याभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ hṛdayenāśaniṃ hṛdayāgreṇa paśupatiṃ kṛtsnahṛdayena bhavaṃ yaknā śarvaṃ matasnābhyāmīśānaṃ manyunā mahādevamantaḥparśavyenograṃ devaṃ vaniṣṭhunā vasiṣṭhahanuḥ śiṅgīni kośyābhyām
verses.en: Agni with the heart; Lightning with the heart's point; Pasupati with the whole heart; Bhava with the liyer. Sarva with the two cardiac bones; Isana with Passion; Mahadeva with the intercostal flesh; the Fierce God with the rectum; Yasishtha-hanuh, Singis with two lumps of flesh near the heart.

verses.sa: उग्रँल्लोहितेन मित्रं सौव्रत्येन रुद्रं दौर्व्रत्येनेन्द्रं प्रक्रीडेन मरुतो बलेन साध्यान् प्रमुदा। भवस्य कण्ठ्यं रुद्रस्यान्तः पार्श्व्यं महादेवस्य यकृच्छर्वस्य वनिष्ठुः पशुपतेः पुरीतत्॥
verses.tr: ugraṃllohitena mitraṃ sauvratyena rudraṃ daurvratyenendraṃ prakrīḍena maruto balena sādhyān pramudā bhavasya kaṇṭhyaṃ rudrasyāntaḥ pārśvyaṃ mahādevasya yakṛccharvasya vaniṣṭhuḥ paśupateḥ purītat
verses.en: The Fierce with blood; Mitra with obedience, Rudra with disobedience; Indra with pastime; the Maruts with strength; the Sadhyas with enjoyment. Bhava's is what is on the throat; Rudra's what is between the ribs; Mahadeva's is the liver; Sarva's the rectum; i Pasupati's the pericardium.

verses.sa: लोमभ्यः स्वाहा लोमभ्यः स्वाहा त्वचे स्वाहा त्वचे स्वाहा लोहिताय स्वाहा लोहिताय स्वाहा मेदोभ्यः स्वाहा मेदोभ्यः स्वाहा। मांसेभ्यः स्वाहा मांसेभ्यः स्वाहा स्नावभ्यः स्वाहा स्नावभ्यः स्वाहा ऽस्थभ्यः स्वाहा स्थभ्यः स्वाहा मज्जभ्यः स्वाहा मज्जभ्यः स्वाहा। रेतसे स्वाहा पायवे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: lomabhyaḥ svāhā lomabhyaḥ svāhā tvace svāhā tvace svāhā lohitāya svāhā lohitāya svāhā medobhyaḥ svāhā medobhyaḥ svāhā māṃsebhyaḥ svāhā māṃsebhyaḥ svāhā snāvabhyaḥ svāhā snāvabhyaḥ svāhā 'sthabhyaḥ svāhā sthabhyaḥ svāhā majjabhyaḥ svāhā majjabhyaḥ svāhā retase svāhā pāyave svāhā
verses.en: To the hair Svaha! To the hair Svaha! To the skin Svaha I To the skin Svaha! To the blood Swihk! To the blood Svaha! To the fats Svaha! To the fats Sviba! To the fleshy parts Svaha! To the fleshy parts Sykhk! To the sinews Svaha! To the sinews Sykhkl! Svaha to the bones!; Svaha to the bones! To the marrows Svaha! To the marrows Svaha! To the seed Svaha.! To the anus Svaha!

verses.sa: आयासाय स्वाहा प्रायासाय स्वाहा संयासाय स्वाहा वियासाय स्वाहोद्यासाय स्वाहा। शुचे स्वाहा शोचते स्वाहा शोचमानाय स्वाहा शोकाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: āyāsāya svāhā prāyāsāya svāhā saṃyāsāya svāhā viyāsāya svāhodyāsāya svāhā śuce svāhā śocate svāhā śocamānāya svāhā śokāya svāhā
verses.en: To Effort Svaha! To Exertion Svaha! To Endeavour Svaha! To Vinasa Svaha! To Attempt Svaha!

verses.sa: तपसे स्वाहा तप्यते स्वाहा तप्यमानाय स्वाहा तप्ताय स्वाहा घर्माय स्वाहा। निष्कृत्यै स्वाहा प्रायश्चित्त्यै स्वाहा भेषजाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: tapase svāhā tapyate svāhā tapyamānāya svāhā taptāya svāhā gharmāya svāhā niṣkṛtyai svāhā prāyaścittyai svāhā bheṣajāya svāhā
verses.en: To Grief Svaha! To the Grieving Svaha! To the Sorrowing Svaha! To Sorrow Svaha! To Heat Svaha! To him who grows hot Svaha! To him who is being heated Svaha! To him who has been heated Svaha! To Gharma Svadha! To Atonement Svaha! To Expiation Svaha! To Remedy Svaha!

verses.sa: यमाय स्वाहा ऽन्तकाय स्वाहा मृत्यवे स्वाहा ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा ब्रह्महत्यायै स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yamāya svāhā 'ntakāya svāhā mṛtyave svāhā brahmaṇe svāhā brahmahatyāyai svāhā viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: To Yama Svaha! To the Finisher Svaha! To Death Svaha! To the Priesthood Svaha! To Brahmanicide Svaha! To the All-Gods Svaha! To Heaven and Earth Svaha!
